name: Glucosamine Sulfate + Chondroitin + Camphor + Peppermint oil
indication_description: This pain-relieving cream is applied topically and provides powerful pain relief of osteoarthritis pain, sprains, simple backache, tendonitis, minor arthritis pain.
pharmacology_description:
Glucosamine is sugar protein that is believed to help in developing and renewing cartilage and keep it lubricated for better joint movement and flexibility.

Chondroitin helps to maintain fluid and flexibility in the joints. The combination of chondroitin and glucosamine is widely used to aid in maintaining healthy joints. It is also used as a nutritional supplement in people with osteoarthritis or other inflammatory joint disorders.

Camphor is a strong smelling compound, chemically manufactured from turpentine oil. When applied to the skin, it stimulates nerve endings to relieve pain, itching and to relieve osteoarthritis.

Peppermint Oil is a strong smelling ingredient can be applied to the skin to treat muscle pain, nerve pain and joint pain.
dosage_description: For the management of osteoarthritis the recommended dose is twice daily into painful muscle and joints for 2-4 week. Apply gently to painful muscles and joints, until this pain relieving cream disappears. Repeat as necessary.
interaction_description: This medicine is not known to interact significantly with other medicines.
side_effects_description: There are no known systemic side effects unless people have an allergy or skin sensitivity to camphor or one of the inactive ingredients.
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: It should not be used during pregnancy & lactation.
precautions_description: Do not apply on broken or irritated skin or if excessive irritation develops. Do not bandage tightly or use a heating pad. Do not swallow. Avoid eye contact or mucous membranes.
storage_conditions_description: Store in a cool and dry place, away from light. keep out of reach of children.
